easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B}. Choose to pay an amount of life and create that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Ingris by paying {4}, creating a 2/2 Cadet creature token and giving creatures you control haste until end of turn.
Declare all eligible creatures you control as attackers.
Ingris triggers for each attacking creature, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
